purpose: Display the prespecified low-burden STAMPEDE Arm H overall-survival result and its applicability limits.

source.license: Original deterministic plot from published aggregate trial values; source article CC BY 4.0

limitations: The 3-year percentages are aggregate trial results, not individual prognosis.
The survival benefit shown is the prespecified low-metastatic-burden subgroup, not the unselected M1 population.
Metastatic burden was defined by conventional imaging; PSMA stage migration requires explicit handling.
